daily_summary: 当日变更覆盖 TLA SIMD 新接口（carry/compaction、predicate pack/unpack、vselr、group reduce、vld2/vgatherb/vscatter、vshrs）、HiFloat8 dtype 全链路接入（MLIR 内置类型 patch、Triton 前端 dtype、semantic、降级 pass、bishengir 版本升级与 submodule 更新）、PtrAnalysis 对运行时对齐指针 bitcast 的支持放宽、DynamicCVPipeline split-if placeholder 对动态 shape 的 fallback、以及若干文档/CI/治理类改动（PR 模板与 issue 标签、maintainers 与治理规则、conv1d/tl.where 约束文档、DynamicCV buffer 选项迁移文档）。核心方向是扩展 Ascend 专属硬件能力表达（TLA/HiF8）并修正指针分析边界，同时完善社区与文档流程。
test_impact_summary: 本次变更显著扩展了需要设备看护的测试面：TLA SIMD 新增大量算子（vaddcs/vsubcs/vcpadd/vsqz/vusqz/ppack/punpack/pintlv/pdintlv/vselr/vcgadd/vcgmax/vcgmin/vld2/vgatherb/vscatter/vshrs）均新增 tla_ut 单测并区分 IR/COMPILE/RUN 三段；HiFloat8 引入新的 MLIR 类型与前端 dtype，新增 arith_hifloat8.mlir lit 测试与 test_hifloat8.py 设备测试，且补丁改动了 LLVM/MLIR 上游文件，需要确认构建与 lit 回归；PtrAnalysis bitcast 放宽后原“拒绝未知单位”用例被改为“接受 runtime 对齐”，测试语义反转，需关注是否引入未对齐 UB 的风险；DynamicCVPipeline 对动态 shape placeholder 走 fallback，新增 else_placeholder_fill.mlir 用例。文档与治理类改动不引入测试点。整体看，现有测试策略已通过新增 tla_ut/pytest_ut/lit 覆盖主要新接口，但 HiFloat8 依赖外部 bishengir 版本与 patch、以及 TLA 新算子仅在 A5/950 上可用，需注意 CI 硬件矩阵与版本锁定的一致性。

commits.comment: PtrAnalysis 放宽对跨元素宽度指针 bitcast 的处理：移除了 widenElement 时要求完整位移可整除的硬失败检查，改为由调用方保证运行时可整除；同时让 base 与 op.getSrc() 相同场景复用 bitcast 结果作为 per-lane base，避免重复构造 bitcast。TritonOpConverter 删除未匹配位宽时的 emitError（改为静默跳过），TritonToUnstructure 移除 canonicalizeSupportedPointerBitcasts 专用重写，让 Unstructure 走正常路径。Utils.cpp 的 divideDecomposition 在存在结构化分解时也允许 scalarOffset 整除。整体意图是支持运行期才可证明对齐的指针 bitcast，减少过度保守的编译失败。风险在于：把整除性从编译期证明转为运行期契约，若用户输入不满足对齐会生成语义错误的 IR；删除错误诊断会降低可调试性；改动触及 PtrAnalysis/Unstructure/TritonToLinalg 三个紧密耦合 pass，需要确认后续 lowering 在非整除情况下仍能正确表达字节缓冲视图。

test_impact.reason: 测试语义发生反转：原 WideningKeepsProvenColumnsAndRejectsUnknownUnits 用例被改为接受 runtime 对齐的动态 offset，并新增 unaligned bitcast 断言分析成功；新增 RetypedPerLaneBaseIsStable C++ 单测；pointer_bitcast_byte_buffer.mlir 的 UNSTRUCTURE/SIMT 检查从期望 divsi+ptr_to_int 改为保留 tt.bitcast 形态；新增 widen_dynamic_origin 场景与 pytest test_pointer_bitcast_runtime_offsets。

commits.message:
[PtrAnalysis](fix) Support runtime-aligned pointer bitcasts (#3432)

* [PtrAnalysis](fix) support runtime-aligned pointer bitcasts

Scale the complete per-lane displacement when widening pointer tensors. Keep proven strides and allow the runtime input to supply divisibility. Use the shared address calculation for byte-buffer views so offsets on both sides of a splat contribute to the quotient.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [Test] Bound bitcast absence checks to each kernel

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [PtrAnalysis] Keep this change scoped to code and tests

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [TritonToLinalg] Simplify pointer bitcast canonicalization

Leave addptr in its original element units. Move pointer bitcasts through splat and combine adjacent casts across pointee widths. Reuse the original SSA value when the round trip restores its type.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [TritonToLinalg] Keep the bitcast change to the width diagnostic

Skip cross-width pointer casts quietly and keep the existing equal-width canonicalization. Drop the round-trip optimization and its dedicated check from the runtime-offset change.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

* [PtrAnalysis] Bypass the dedicated byte-buffer bitcast rewrite

Let Unstructure and the later lowering consume cross-width pointers through the normal path. Check the source byte displacements and the pointers used by loads and stores in both modes, alongside the final word offsets.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

commits.message:
[TLA](feat) simd interfaces (#3160)

* [ascend](feat) add TLA SIMD carry and compaction ops

Add vaddcs/vsubcs/vcpadd/vsqz/vusqz frontend and builder bindings. Keep vsubc out because NPUIR no longer provides VsubcOp.

* [ascend](test) run TLA SIMD carry/compaction UTs on device

Upgrade the carry/vcpadd/vsqz/vusqz unit tests from IR-only checks to the
full IR -> compile -> run pipeline, matching the other tla_ut SIMD cases:

- add _launch() helpers that issue one real kernel launch on NPU;
- add test_compile() using check_compile_artifacts() to assert a .npubin/.o
  artifact was produced in TRITON_CACHE_DIR;
- drive all three stages from __main__ via get_stages();
- vusqz: drop the hand-rolled bishengir-compile subprocess/LLVM-IR check
  (~36 lines) in favour of the shared launch + artifact check.

Validated on Ascend950PR_9589 (test machine, CANN 9.2.0-beta.2) with
triton_ascend 3.6.0.dev0+gitd5027f39: carry/vcpadd/vsqz/vusqz all pass
IR, COMPILE and RUN.

* [ascend](feat) add AVE register and indexed memory APIs

Add ppack, punpack, pintlv, pdintlv, vselr and vcgadd/max/min through AVE.
Complete vcadd and vld2 by composing existing reduction, load and
deinterleave operations; expose AVE block gather and indexed scatter.
Expose vshrs through the existing AVE scalar right-shift op and share
scalar-shift validation with vshls. Export the API and test signed and
unsigned 8/16/32-bit data, masks and constexpr/runtime shift amounts.
Pin NPU-IR to bd88eea996b4, which contains the register/indexed-memory
implementation and the unchanged utility/carry patch from MR 4749.

Group reductions support Ascend950 only. All vselr indices must be in
range, including inactive lanes. vld2 supports contiguous 1D UB buffers
with matching DINTLV_B16/B32 distributions. vgatherb and vscatter initially
support 32-bit UB data and uint32 indices. Block offsets are byte offsets
aligned to four bytes; scatter indices are element offsets and active
destinations must be distinct. Dependent vector accesses require the
documented barriers. Broader dtypes, distributions and address-update
modes remain deferred; MR 4749's new operations are not exposed here.
Scalar shifts keep the existing mode contract: MERGING uses a zero source,
so inactive lanes are zero rather than preserving a previous destination.

Validation used main-dev b51a67e7e6e5 as the TLA baseline. The remote TLA
checkout was 66b1f9be1 with this source patch and the amended NPU-IR sources
overlaid; its gitlink was overridden for the joint build. NPU-IR LLVM19
tools and the TLA LLVM22 extension built successfully. On Ascend950PR_9579
with CANN 9.2 beta2 and BISHENG_BACKEND=process, the final implementation
passed 989 joint checks and nine focused NPU-IR lit files before the vshrs
addition. With vshrs added, the TLA extension rebuilt successfully and
204 new checks passed (12 IR and 192 device), along with 190 frontend
contract checks. Four existing shift checks failed in CPU reference
generation because this PyTorch build lacks uint16/uint32 torch.where;
the reference-adapted rerun timed out and is not counted as passing.

The existing build harness reused 35 template bitcode files and the
documented no-vendor-header workaround. Native mode, Ascend960, performance
and MR 4749's new operations on hardware were not tested.

* [ascend](style): apply yapf to vcpadd/vsqz TLA UTs

Keep the two kernel launches on one line; both fit column_limit=120
(116 and 114 columns), which is what the repo yapf hook expects now that
the calls were split manually.
